title: VACHAN hackathon contract review benchmark
status: illustrative engineering benchmark; not lawyer-labelled or validated

expected_checks: Transfer of Property Act section 107 registration review
Do not assume stamp duty exemption
Check state tenancy law and execution requirements

cases.scenario: Supplier claims micro/small enterprise registration and payment term is 90 days
expected_checks: Flag section 15 45-day maximum agreed period where applicable
Flag Indian Contract Act section 27 issue for legal review

cases.scenario: Confidentiality clause lacks exclusions and permitted disclosures
expected_checks: Identify missing exclusions and permitted disclosure provisions

cases.scenario: Goods description, inspection and warranty terms are missing
expected_checks: Identify missing goods description, inspection and warranty terms

cases.scenario: Agreement does not describe partner roles, contributions or dissolution
expected_checks: Identify missing partner rights/duties and dissolution mechanics

cases.scenario: Loan agreement has no repayment dates or default process
expected_checks: Identify missing repayment, default and security terms
legal_basis: Indian Contract Act 1872; applicable state/sector law

cases.scenario: IP assignment does not identify rights, duration or territory
expected_checks: Flag written assignment and section 19 particulars for review

cases.scenario: MOU does not state which clauses are binding
legal_basis: Indian Contract Act 1872; exact drafting and facts
